file_role: Frozen reference table for the sanctioned minimum-viable pattern stand-in (charter annex A-patterns) plus the traditional marker register. Reference only: explicit chart fields win on any conflict (authority_precedence rule).

patterns.note: enumerates every 天/地/寄 stem instance per palace; feeds P3-GATE
reconciles computed stem pairs against explicit markers of shape X加Y
markers that are not stem pairs (gate/house relations, special combinations, twelve stages)

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 辛为狱神，丁为星奇。经商获利倍增，囚人逢天赦获释。
markers.gloss_en: Prison-god meets the star-goddess: doubled gain in trade; release/reversal for the confined.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 朱雀投江。文书口舌是非，消息如沉江中，音信不到。
markers.gloss_en: Vermilion bird drowns: documents and speech go astray; messages sink and do not arrive.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 复见螣蛇。事物反复波折，可能更换合作方。重复犯错不改。
markers.gloss_en: Flying serpent again: repeated reversals, possible change of partner; error repeated unchanged.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 太白退位。远行迷失道路，男女音信难通。移荡格：谋事迂回曲折，主换地方。
markers.gloss_en: White metal abdicates: journeys lose the road, messages between people fail; the Wandering disposition — plans take detours and change location.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 青龙折足。吉事成凶，动必受伤。
markers.gloss_en: Azure dragon breaks a foot: a good matter turns harmful; movement brings injury.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 太白同宫（战格）。凡事难遂争斗不休，官灾横祸。利客不利主，利攻不利守。
markers.gloss_en: Two white metals in one palace (War disposition): chronic contention, official trouble; favourable to the visitor/attacker, unfavourable to the host/defender.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 凶蛇入狱。大祸将成，夫妻不睦。难以脱身，阴谋纠缠。词讼理亏。
markers.gloss_en: Fierce serpent enters prison: entanglement, no exit, concealed scheming; losing position in disputes.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 利阴害阳。利阴人（女子），不利阳人（男子）。门吉尚可谋，门凶或迫则破财伤人。
markers.gloss_en: Favours the yin party, harms the yang party; workable while the gate is auspicious, otherwise loss.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 日月并行。丙乙两奇相佐，阴阳调和。公私谋划合宜顺利，特别利于合作事务。
markers.gloss_en: Sun and moon move together: the two qi assist each other; public and private plans go smoothly, especially co-operative matters.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 火悖地户。火炎土燥，主阻碍纠缠。先暗后明。
markers.gloss_en: Fire rebels at the earth door: obstruction and entanglement; first dark, then light.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 丁为玉女。值使门飞到地盘丁所在宫位，玉女暗中护佑。极利婚姻、宴会、喜乐、和合之事，万事遂心。有贵人暗中相助。
markers.gloss_en: The Jade Maiden guards the gate: the duty gate lands on the palace holding earth-plate Ding; hidden patronage, excellent for alliance, celebration and quiet dealings.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 环境（宫）主动生旺人事（门）。天降好运、得贵人相助、毫不费力。
markers.gloss_en: The house feeds the gate: the environment supports the human action; effort is amplified.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 环境（宫）克制人事（门）。处处受限、有志难伸、被打压。
markers.gloss_en: The house presses the gate: the environment constrains the action; ambitions are held down.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 人事（门）克制环境（宫）。强行作为、吃力不讨好、引发环境反噬。吉门被迫吉减半，凶门被迫加倍凶。
markers.gloss_en: The gate presses the house: forcing action against the environment; an auspicious gate halves its benefit, an inauspicious gate doubles its harm.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 人事（门）主动生旺环境（宫）。有付出有回报，顺水推舟。加三奇更吉。
markers.gloss_en: The gate feeds the house: effort returns value; stronger still when the three qi are present.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 三奇受到相克之干的压制。奇能虽在，却被锁住无法发挥。主贵人帮不上忙，能力受限。
markers.gloss_en: The three qi are checked: the extraordinary capacity is locked; the helpful party cannot reach you.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 值符为八神之首，百恶消散、所到皆吉，主清贵、正统、有外力庇佑。
markers.gloss_en: Chief of the eight spirits: disperses the inauspicious, marks the legitimate/authoritative position.

markers.classical_meaning_cn: 暗干主隐蔽、潜在、未显之事，与天盘同干时主事情表面与内里一致。
markers.gloss_en: Hidden stem: matters concealed, latent, not yet surfaced; identical to the heaven stem means surface and interior agree.

twelve_stages.gloss_en: growth begins — sprouting, founding, lively and favourable
bathing/peach-blossom — pliant, exposed to attraction and instability
attending office — capable, career-peak, resources flowing
imperial prosperity — energy at maximum; guard against reversal
decline — momentum fading, hold rather than attack
death — no movement; keep still, do not force
tomb/storehouse — energy sealed, locked in, obscured
cut-off — old qi exhausted, new qi not yet born; fragile but turns
conception — form not yet visible, latent potential
nurture — consolidation, storing strength before release

gate_register.gloss_en: Rest gate — pause, recourse, quiet assistance
Wound gate — contest, force, damage to what is struck
View gate — display, documents, what is shown
Death gate — termination, finality, what is closed
Fright gate — alarm, dispute, what is spooked
